issue.title: test_repeat_select_caches_content_read counts process-wide builtins.open, so anything else opening a file in the worker fails it
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_artifact_file_cache.py::test_repeat_select_caches_content_read failed once under the full parallel lane and passes on a focused rerun.

EVIDENCE: durable selection store ~/.sase/test-selection/gh_sase-org__sase/20260817T011832Z-4819a03141f7-3122359-full-run.json records it in 'failures' at 2026-08-17T01:37:53Z, HEAD 4819a03141f7, workspace sase_22, changed_files ['tests/test_bead/test_flag_gate_response.py'] -- a diff that cannot touch prompt-artifact caching. Reported as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP by phase bead sase-nb.11.4 during epic sase-nb.11. Isolated rerun on HEAD 6000a54a1: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_artifact_file_cache.py -> 3 passed. This is the only failure record for the node in the whole store, so it is below the flake gate's reproducible bar and is NOT in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt.

ROOT CAUSE (from the test source, tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_artifact_file_cache.py:97-124): the test wraps 'patch("builtins.open", side_effect=counting_open)' around three get_prompt_content() calls and then asserts 'open_count == baseline' exactly. builtins.open is process-wide, so any other code executing in that xdist worker during the patched window -- a background thread (config-cache refresh, monitor reconciliation), an atexit/GC finalizer, or lazy module state -- increments open_count and fails the assertion even though the artifact cache behaved correctly. The cache under test is also process-global (sase.agent.artifact_files_cache.get_global_cache()), which the test clears at entry but which nothing prevents another actor from touching.

SCOPE: stop asserting on a process-wide builtins.open count. Count reads through a seam owned by the module under test instead -- the same shape commit d9b2984a7 ('fix(tui): isolate config center state replacement') used to replace a process-wide os.replace patch with a module-local file-replacement hook -- or assert on the cache's own read counters. Keep the behavioural assertion (repeat get_prompt_content() calls must not re-read the prompt body from disk) intact.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for full-parallel-lane-only test flakes; its close reason forbids +1 and directs narrow node-specific beads, which is why this was filed as its own task.
